Both are already linked to 149 common concepts, including multi asset option, cev model and exotic derivative, which suggests the methods and data needed to connect them already exist. We propose a study that uses multi asset option as a bridge: first, review how local volatility and runtime are each currently treated through multi asset option; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.
